description: Corrected domain analysis excluding whole-gene deletions, with size-adjusted logistic regression
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import statsmodels.api as sm
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

D=pd.read_csv("clinvar_dmd_cnv_exonmapped.csv")
dele=D[D.obj_type.isin(["Deletion","copy number loss"])].copy()
print("all exon-mapped pathogenic deletions:", len(dele))

# ---- CORRECTION: terminal / whole-gene deletions cannot have a meaningful reading frame.
# Total DMD coding length = 11058 bp, which is divisible by 3, so a whole-gene deletion
# is spuriously scored "in-frame" by a coding-span mod-3 rule.
dele["terminal"] = (dele.first_exon<=1) | (dele.last_exon>=79)
print("terminal / whole-gene-spanning deletions (frame undefined):", int(dele.terminal.sum()))
print("  of which scored 'in-frame' by naive mod3 rule:", int(((dele.frame_mod3==0)&dele.terminal).sum()))

intr=dele[~dele.terminal].copy()
intr["frame"]=np.where(intr.frame_mod3==0,"in-frame","out-of-frame")
print("\nINTRAGENIC pathogenic deletions (frame interpretable):", len(intr))
print(intr.frame.value_counts().to_string())

DOMAINS=[("ABD1 actin-binding",2,8),("Hinge 1",9,10),("Rod R1-R15",11,41),
         ("Rod R16-R17 nNOS",42,45),("Rod R18-R24/H3",46,62),
         ("Cysteine-rich beta-DG",63,70),("C-terminal",71,79)]
for name,a,b in DOMAINS:
    intr[name]=intr.apply(lambda r: not (r.last_exon<a or r.first_exon>b), axis=1)

inf=intr[intr.frame=="in-frame"]; oof=intr[intr.frame=="out-of-frame"]
print(f"\nMedian exons deleted: in-frame {inf.n_exons.median():.0f} (IQR {inf.n_exons.quantile(.25):.0f}-{inf.n_exons.quantile(.75):.0f}), "
      f"out-of-frame {oof.n_exons.median():.0f} (IQR {oof.n_exons.quantile(.25):.0f}-{oof.n_exons.quantile(.75):.0f})")
u,pu=stats.mannwhitneyu(inf.n_exons, oof.n_exons)
print(f"Mann-Whitney U on deletion size (n exons): p={pu:.3g}")

rows=[]
for name,a,b in DOMAINS:
    ai=int(inf[name].sum()); ao=int(oof[name].sum())
    orr,p=stats.fisher_exact([[ai,len(inf)-ai],[ao,len(oof)-ao]])
    # size-adjusted logistic regression: domain ~ frame + n_exons
    y=intr[name].astype(int).values
    X=sm.add_constant(np.column_stack([(intr.frame=="in-frame").astype(int).values, intr.n_exons.values]))
    try:
        m=sm.Logit(y,X).fit(disp=0)
        adj_or=np.exp(m.params[1]); adj_p=m.pvalues[1]
    except Exception:
        adj_or,adj_p=np.nan,np.nan
    rows.append(dict(domain=name, exons=f"{a}-{b}", inframe_n=ai, inframe_pct=100*ai/len(inf),
                     oof_n=ao, oof_pct=100*ao/len(oof), crude_OR=orr, crude_p=p,
                     size_adj_OR=adj_or, size_adj_p=adj_p))
T=pd.DataFrame(rows)
T["crude_p_fdr"]=multipletests(T.crude_p,method="fdr_bh")[1]
T["adj_p_fdr"]=multipletests(T.size_adj_p.fillna(1),method="fdr_bh")[1]
print("\nIntragenic pathogenic deletions: domain involvement by frame effect")
print(T.to_string(index=False, float_format=lambda x: f"{x:.3g}"))
T.to_csv("clinvar_dmd_domain_frame_test_corrected.csv", index=False)
intr.to_csv("clinvar_dmd_intragenic_deletions.csv", index=False)

# phenotype crosstab on corrected set
ex=intr[intr.pheno.isin(["DMD","BMD"])]
ct=pd.crosstab(ex.frame,ex.pheno).reindex(index=["out-of-frame","in-frame"],columns=["DMD","BMD"]).fillna(0)
print("\nIntragenic deletions vs exclusive ClinVar label:\n",ct)
orr,p=stats.fisher_exact(ct.values); print(f"Fisher OR={orr:.3g}, p={p:.3g}, N={int(ct.values.sum())}")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,5))
y=np.arange(len(T)); w=.38
axes[0].barh(y-w/2,T.inframe_pct,w,label=f"in-frame (n={len(inf)})",color="#55A868")
axes[0].barh(y+w/2,T.oof_pct,w,label=f"out-of-frame (n={len(oof)})",color="#C44E52")
axes[0].set_yticks(y); axes[0].set_yticklabels([f"{d} (ex {e})" for d,e in zip(T.domain,T.exons)],fontsize=8)
axes[0].set_xlabel("% of deletions removing the domain"); axes[0].legend(fontsize=8)
axes[0].set_title("Intragenic pathogenic DMD deletions\n(whole-gene deletions excluded)")
for i,(a,b_) in enumerate(zip(T.inframe_pct,T.oof_pct)):
    axes[0].text(a+1,i-w/2,f"{a:.0f}%",va="center",fontsize=7); axes[0].text(b_+1,i+w/2,f"{b_:.0f}%",va="center",fontsize=7)
axes[1].scatter(oof.n_exons, oof.first_exon, s=18, color="#C44E52", alpha=.6, label="out-of-frame")
axes[1].scatter(inf.n_exons, inf.first_exon, s=18, color="#55A868", alpha=.6, label="in-frame")
axes[1].set_xscale("log"); axes[1].set_xlabel("exons deleted (log)"); axes[1].set_ylabel("first deleted exon")
axes[1].set_title(f"Size and position of pathogenic deletions\nMann-Whitney on size p={pu:.2g}")
axes[1].axhspan(63,70,color="k",alpha=.08); axes[1].text(1.2,66,"cysteine-rich",fontsize=7)
axes[1].legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
